kpis.description: Indicator of future subscription revenue growth

risks.title: Loss of customers and revenue
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the beginning of Risk Factors and repeated multiple times, highlighting the critical importance of customer acquisition and retention for revenue. The impact on financial position is direct and explicit.

risks.title: Increased competition and technological obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Strongly emphasized with explicit mention of AI as a competitive factor. The intensity of language ('highly competitive', 'rapidly changing') and the risk of failure to adapt justify a high severity score.

risks.title: Dependence on data and intellectual property
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in a dedicated section of Risk Factors. The inability to maintain accurate data or protect intellectual property, including against AI, is presented as having a direct impact on the business and competitive position.

risks.title: Economic and sector volatility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned multiple times and details the impact of global economic uncertainties and real estate sector consolidation. The language ('uncertainties', 'downturns', 'adversely affect') indicates a major concern.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data breach risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in Risk Factors with serious consequences noted. The growing importance of cybersecurity for a data platform makes this risk particularly relevant.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned with potential consequences on operations and financial position. The success of acquisitions (Matterport, Domain) is presented as a key factor, but also a source of risk if poorly managed.

risks.title: International operations risks
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in Risk Factors, highlighting exposure to increased risks (regulatory, economic) and currency exchange rate volatility. International expansion via Domain (Australia) and OnTheMarket (UK) introduces new complexities.

ai_positioning.summary: CoStar Group mentions artificial intelligence in a competitive context (risk of technological obsolescence with AI as a competitive factor) but does not detail significant in-house AI initiatives in the 10-K analyzed.
evidence: Item 1A: Risk Factors mention 'highly competitive and rapidly changing market' with AI as competitive factor
Item 1A: Data and intellectual property protection risks mention 'new technologies like AI'
